marketed_identity: Applied; Goya; Sano; Crown; Lou Rose; later Guild/Hohner OEM identities
model_or_product: Applied Fuzz and Treble Booster; Big Fuzz; Goya Panther/Fury/Boom Box/Power Box; Guild FW-3/VW-1/SP-5; Hohner ME-30
evidence_summary: Recent historical research identifies Applied Audio Products Inc. as a significant New Jersey manufacturer/OEM behind the Applied Fuzz and Treble Booster and multiple Goya, Sano, Crown and Lou Rose effects. A 1968 factory report places Applied Audio with associate organization Trans-Tek in South Plainfield and explicitly says the facility built amplifiers and effects including the Applied Big Fuzz. Later research documents Applied-built Guild and Hohner effects. Preserve the OEM/brand relationships rather than promoting Goya, Sano, Crown, Lou Rose, Guild or Hohner into duplicate factories.

model_or_product: FZ002 gated bass fuzz; Brown Dog
evidence_summary: Richard Cartwright's company history and Chunk's own documentation establish a Sydney/Australian handmade pedal business beginning in 1995. The FZ002 is explicitly documented as a handmade Australian bass fuzz later made obsolete by and superseded with the Brown Dog. Preserve FZ002 and Brown Dog as a product lineage, not separate builders.
